# Game conditions and weather

`game.conditions` starts, lists and ends game conditions such as eclipses, cold snaps and heat waves. `game.weather` (more than get and set) reports the sky, the season and the weather defs. The kits are Experimental in the [stability tiers](stability.md). `game.weather.current` and `set` read and change the weather.

```lua
-- A short cold snap on the current map
game.conditions.start("ColdSnap", { duration = 30000 })
print(game.conditions.temperature_offset())
```

## Functions

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `game.conditions.list` | `h?` | `RimConditionInfo[]` | Active game conditions on a map, or on the world when no map is loaded. |
| `game.conditions.defs` |  | `RimConditionDef[]` | Every game condition def. |
| `game.conditions.start` | `def, opts?, h?` | `boolean` | Starts a game condition such as ColdSnap or HeatWave. |
| `game.conditions.stop` | `def, h?` | `integer` | Ends a game condition. Returns how many were ended. |
| `game.conditions.temperature_offset` | `h?` | `number` | Total temperature offset from active conditions. |
| `game.weather.defs` |  | `RimWeatherDef[]` | Every weather def. |
| `game.weather.sky` | `h?` | `RimSky` | Light, wind, weather transition and temperature of a map. |
| `game.weather.season` | `h?` | `RimSeason` | Season and how far into the year the map is. |
